text: Judge the current full and compact previews before completing the contract. Name the first read, its comfortably readable explanation, and what the artwork adds. Recognizing known words or deciphering enlarged text is not comfortable reading.
Lost essential product content, unreadable support or a broken message group requires rejection and a coherent repair, not an advisory polish warning.
The direction is a plan to assess; it cannot certify its own aesthetic choices.
note: Right principle, but the acceptance rule below (L68) makes the direction's own preserve/review_needs the checklist.

text: critique.json contract: SceneVisualCritique with accepted, summary, issues (severity info|warning|error|blocker; categories incl. brand_fit and request_satisfaction), repair_instruction, acceptance_notes, requirement_coverage_notes, confidence, reference_fidelity, direction_review.
On reference turns supply reference_fidelity: score 0–3 (0 ignored, 1 palette only, 2 visual system with missed details, 3 faithful), reasons, regressed_to_house_style.

direction_review: direction_digest, scope whole_creative|scoped_edit, checks (section preserve|review_needs, index, status met|deviation|unverified, notes), copy_occurrences (fragments, support, readability) … Put source_gaps INSIDE support.
A valid, deliberately unverified REJECTED example follows (JSON). Replace its digest, indices, IDs and words; it is not a passing review.
Acceptance requires every preserve and review_needs item exactly once, all met.
note: CIRCULAR REVIEW: both lists are written by the agent in its own direction. There is no required check that the user's request was met or that the result is on-brand.

text: Bind every declared copy ID and every nonempty native text node … using render_preview's complete inventory or inspect(view="copy_review") … Every occurrence needs support supported or nonfactual, explicit support.source_gaps: [], and readability readable.

Never turn unverified into met/readable just to register. Notes, empty gaps and schema validity are not proof of taste/truth. Whole acceptance also needs clean current preflight, current preview/view and a current registered accepted critique.
A caller-selected native_copy_review_profile also applies; no score waives a failure.
scoped_edit requires a seeded validated intent=edit turn; review its named edit and relevant copy. It can support edit_applied, never final whole-creative accepted.
note: Conflicts with the follow-up routine (A1), which finalizes edit_applied with no critique.json and no re-validated direction.

text: Judge the actual rendered scene at full view and final placement size. Read the supporting sentence in the compact placement preview without referring back to the larger image … If it is only decipherable when enlarged, mark it unreadable and repair.
For paired identities, check that the advertiser is recognizable as the sender; a target logo must not overpower a shrunken advertiser mark.

For a support-size repair, compare that occurrence before and after at the same viewing scale, and verify that the approved headline and artwork are unchanged … Compare against a supplied user correction and retain that design's successful size, measure and grouping.

Review target facts and advertiser capability promises separately. An imperative or invitation can still add an unsupported promise … if absent, record added_meaning and reject until sourced or removed.

Check idea/copy, evidence and attribution, hierarchy, readable contrast, brand identity, authentic product crop, independent editable layers and reference treatment. Compare the reference's visual invariants against the actual rendered relationships, not merely matching palette or motif.
note: The only brand check in review is against "the reference" the agent chose; there is no check against the brand's published look as a whole.

text: A missing CTA is not a defect when the objective needs none; a present CTA must have the right next step, brand-supported form, measured label and readable local contrast.

Read the composite as a short visual argument: first read, the support that belongs to it, and what the artwork explains … Whitespace earns its place by strengthening hierarchy or reference treatment.
For combined images, name what each contributes … Test the weaker element by mentally removing it; if meaning and brand recognition survive and hierarchy improves, simplify.
Inspect the whole palette at once: independent product pixels may retain their real colors, while authored type, fields and buttons follow the selected treatment and explicit user corrections.
Record failures in critique issues … Preserve successful user-edited groups and source treatments. A visual repair may require replacing the chosen concept or removing an optional element.

For account adaptation, first read the original request and the complete current feed preview before using the direction's checks as a checklist … A self-authored identity-only plan cannot narrow a request for account relevance. Matching that plan is not acceptance evidence for the original brief.
note: The anti-circular rule exists, but only for account adaptation and only for "account relevance".

text: Each authentic logo and the native separator must remain independently editable; preserve advertiser voice, type, palette and approved groups unless a departure was requested.
note: Same brand rule as D13 L107, again account-only and again "unless a departure was requested".

text: Check exact identity against its source … Co-placement is not evidence for customer, partner or endorsement claims … remove the name and logo mentally: the remaining artwork and companion copy must still connect a supported capability to the supplied audience or task.

When expected text or artwork is absent, first locate it in inspect(view="page"|"node_tree"), then inspect its and its ancestors' geometry … consider clipping, off-canvas placement, opacity, alpha … mark unverified when the cause cannot be established.

Preflight validates mechanics, not taste or fidelity. Inspect the image itself; do not accept because a tool returned success or a previous round looked good. After a repair, the new scene needs its own render and view … Avoid retrying an identical failed treatment.
The earlier controls provide negative evidence: self-accepted white-on-pale copy, an unsupported luminous motif, a substituted wordmark treatment, and a product crop too small to communicate.
note: "Earlier controls" refers to test runs the agent never saw.

text: Use the tool's indexed requirements; cover every preserve and review_needs item once … Accepted requires all items met … If a different direction is justified within the user's scope, revise it explicitly with a reason, validate it and review that result.
Use the complete native-copy inventory … The forty-row text-size display is a truncated aid, never the inventory … Every nonempty native text node in the exported pages needs coverage.

For every occurrence, including claim_kind=positioning, read the exact words … Identify subject, action, condition and outcome, including scope and certainty … Catalog labels/descriptions are supplied assertions … Support judges faithfulness at that source scope, not external truth.
Compare relationships, not matching feature nouns … Read implied timing, control, causality, availability and authority before classifying the claim.
note: Third copy of the implied-meaning rule (D1 L37, D13 L65).

text: For quantitative proof, read the number and its visible companions as one claim … Context recorded only in evidence, assumptions or review notes is not visible qualification … never fabricate qualifiers.
Record source_gaps as a list of {kind, reason} before choosing the support status … candidate acceptance requires an explicit empty list for every occurrence.
Support statuses: supported, nonfactual, unsupported, unverified (definitions) … Give one concise reason; in source_limits state the depicted, supplied-assertion or verified scope actually available.
Readability status readable|unreadable|unverified with a placement-specific reason … There is no universal font-size threshold.

When a caller-selected native_copy_review_profile is reported, its viewing assumption is part of this run's contract … legible-feed-v1 uses 10px nominal em at 360px display width (30 source px for a 1080px page) … This is an internal review condition, not a platform specification.
note: Every candidate turn gets legible-feed-v1 via brief.md (H1); "no universal font-size threshold" (L316) and this 30px floor sit side by side.

text: For a seeded, validated intent=edit turn, scope="scoped_edit" may review only the named edit and relevant copy … A passing scoped review can support edit_applied … no additional reviewer round is required.
note: Repeats L85; conflicts with the follow-up routine.
